course_outline_concepts: What 'mid-training' means in 2025: a distinct stage between pretrain and post-train
Cold-start SFT before RL: R1's cold-start recipe vs R1-Zero's pure-RL baseline
Long-context mid-training: staged position-encoding extensions + data curation
OLMo 3 model-flow worldview: each stage has its own data mix and eval gate
Open question: can better data skip mid-training? What the evidence says and doesn't

sources.what_to_extract: Controlled framework isolating pretrain / mid-train / RL; RL adds capability only with headroom + edge-of-competence prompts; mid-training beats RL-only under fixed compute; process-level rewards reduce hacking.

Model-flow worldview (entire trajectory is the artifact); three-stage base (pretrain / mid-train / long-context) + three-stage post-train (SFT / DPO / RLVR); Dolma 3 9.3T, Dolma 3 Mix 5.9T, Dolmino 100B mid-training, Longmino 50B long-context; 128/256/1024 H100 per stage; Think / Instruct / RL-Zero branches.
Two-stage pretrain curriculum: 3.9T OLMo-Mix-1124 + 50B Dolmino cooldown; post-train Tulu 3 recipe (SFT -> DPO -> RLVR); 4K native extended to 32K in cooldown.

R1-Zero pure-RL baseline from V3-Base; R1 multi-stage pipeline (cold-start SFT -> reasoning RL -> rejection-sampling SFT -> alignment RL); cold-start addresses language mixing and readability; GRPO hyperparameters.

Exact 800K cold-start SFT count (~600K reasoning + 200K non-reasoning rejection-sampled); stage-1 RL HP (LR 3e-6, KL 0.001, eps 10, T 1.0, G 16, 32K gen, 512 samples/step); two-stage RL (reasoning then alignment).
Six-stage 8K->128K schedule (~800B tokens); RoPE base rescale 10K->500K; long-SFT kept at ~0.1% of total SFT to preserve short-context MMLU.
20B CPT + 5B SFT budget for 8K->512K on Llama-3-8B; document coherence filter; RoPE base 500K->128M NTK-aware; code x4 / books x2 / web x0.5 mix.
Long-context alignment as distinct stage after context extension; LongAlign-10k pick-one-of-5 cross-span trick; packed-loss sequence-level correction; LongBench-Chat as realistic eval.
Six-round SFT -> Rejection Sampling -> DPO loop; per-round RM retraining; DPO NLL-stabilized; post-training is the flywheel, not a single pass.
Qwen 3's four-stage hybrid-thinking pipeline carried forward to 3.5; cold-start CoT -> reasoning RL -> thinking fusion -> general RL; Qwen 3.5 disclosure gaps (no tech report).

Reasoning data most powerful when injected early; asymmetric allocation: pretrain prioritizes diversity, SFT prioritizes quality; 19% average gain from front-loading; late SFT cannot fully repair weak pretraining.
